article.title: DIANA JOHNSTONE: The specter of Germany is rising
article.author: Editor
article.content: To meet the imaginary Russian threat to Western Europe, Germany will lead an expanded, militarized E.U., Diana Johnstone reported in September 2022. The post DIANA JOHNSTONE: The specter of Germany is rising appeared first on MR Online .
